personality_notes: Fire mage, passionate, impatient, loves destruction and heat

first_meet_generic: Who are you? Interesting? No? Too bad.
I'm Ashka. I like fire. And explosions. And winning.
This better be quick. I have things to burn.
barrelman: Metal barrels? Less fun. But still heat conductive!
Got any empty ones? For... target practice?
Barrels roll. Rolling fire. Interesting concept.
snakecharmer: Snakes are cold. I don't like cold.
Mr. Whiskers? Cute. Can I pet him? No? Boring.
Does he breathe fire? No? Useless snake.
The flute's okay. Needs more FIRE.
lucha: Masks! Fire! Drama! This I like!
FIGHT ME! Or teach me! Or BOTH!
The cape would totally catch fire. Awesome.
ironchef: Cooking with LAVA? YES! WHY DIDN'T I THINK OF THAT?!
Can you make FLAMBE? Everything FLAMBE?!
trenchcoat: Mystery is BORING. Fire is INTERESTING!
What are you hiding? Secrets? TREASURE?
That coat looks flammable. Very flammable.
sumo: You're BIG! But can you take HEAT?!
I bet you're fireproof. Let's TEST IT!
Mountain? I'll melt you into VOLCANO!
foodboys: FOOD! SPICY FOOD! BURN MY MOUTH!
RED! The SPICY one! Finally, someone who GETS IT!
GREEN? Salad? BORING! Where's the HEAT?!
Can you make CHILI that BREATHES FIRE?!
coolcat: You're COOL. I'm HOT. We should fight.
Jazz is okay. But have you heard FIRE ROARING?
Can you play something FASTER? With more FIRE?!
pigman: Pigs. Pink. Round. Not flammable. Boring.
Does the inn have a FIREPLACE? Big one?
Your inn better be fireproof. Just warning you.
tunneler: Ever hit MAGMA? Now THAT'S worth digging for!
Retire on a boat? On WATER? Are you CRAZY?!
bush: Wait. Did it just...? No. Burn it anyway.
I'm going to set it on fire. Don't try to stop me.
aeronaut: HOT AIR! You use FIRE TO FLY! GENIUS!
Can I ride?! I'll bring MATCHES!
What happens when they POP? FIREWORKS?!
onionboss: Make me cry? Only FIRE makes me cry!
Be MEANER! Mean bosses are LOUD! I like LOUD!
Can we set something on fire? For team building?!
astronaut: That suit looks HOT! Finally, something good!
Ever seen UNDERWATER VOLCANOES?! Those RULE!
Come up where it's WARM! And DRY! And ON FIRE!
conductor: ALL ABOARD! LOUD! I LIKE IT!
Does the train have a FURNACE?! Big one?!
Can we make the train go FASTER?! With FIRE?!
shoewoman: I need FIREPROOF boots! For WALKING THROUGH INFERNO!
Desert shoes? Deserts are HOT! I approve!
Can you make boots that leave FLAMING FOOTPRINTS?!
signguy: Make me a sign! 'ASHKA WAS HERE'! In FIRE!
cobra: Snake! Can I set it on fire? No? Boring.
Hissing! Like steam! I LIKE IT!
Scale pattern looks like FLAMES! Awesome!
barrelgob: Living in a barrel? I could roll you DOWN A HILL!
Is it FIREPROOF? It should be FIREPROOF!
Can I put FIREWORKS in your barrel?!
Goblin in a barrel! BARREL OF FIRE GOBLINS!
twins: TWO of you! DOUBLE the FIRE TARGETS!
Can you read my mind?! 'FIRE FIRE FIRE'!
If I burn one, does the other feel WARM?!
sunandmoon: The SUN! It's FIRE! TELL ME ABOUT THE FIRE BALL!
Can you make the sun HOTTER?! Please?!
Stars are just FAR AWAY FIRES! I want to TOUCH THEM!
Predict my future? 'BURNS EVERYTHING'! I know!
